description: Create a heartbeat (push) check for a cron job or worker: it goes down if StatusCake is not pinged within `period` seconds. Returns the new id as data.new_id; fetch it with statuscake_get_heartbeat_check to get the ping URL. StatusCake: POST /heartbeat.

contact_groups.description: Contact group ids to alert (see statuscake_list_contact_groups). An empty list clears them.

period.description: Seconds since the last ping before the check is down, 30-172800 (e.g. 1800).

tags.description: Tags for the check. An empty list clears them.

name: statuscake_create_heartbeat_check
title: Create a heartbeat check
